text:
taylor: Heads-up: we're updating the release train gating for this sprint. Main points: stricter pre-canary smoke, per-model perf thresholds, and a small shift to the canary window. Please ack when you see it.

taylor: New canary window: Thu 03:00-07:00 UTC (moved +1h). Freeze still Sat 00:00 - Mon 06:00 UTC.

taylor: Quick checklist (short, required before flip):
- `make smoke` on the canary artifact
- perf: model-specific P95 must be <= baseline * 1.12 (12% headroom)
- errors: sustained error rate must be < 1% over 5m post-flip
- add `release:gated` label to PRs requiring the canary path

indra: Ack. Can you publish the baseline numbers?

taylor: baseline dashboards posted here: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/release-baselines (eng-release access).

kai: We have a small data-migration queued Fri night for user-config. That one should move to the calmer window per the new policy?

taylor: Yes, non-critical migrations should not run inside or immediately before freeze. Move to the next calm window and note it in the migration PR. If you need an exception, ping eng-release + eng-sre with risk mitigation.

devops-bot: smoke suite updated for train-1764: added `check:dedi-routing` and `check:kv-cache` tests. :gear: 

release-bot: Automated: toggling back to prior gating requires formal approval. See /policies/release-gates for exception process.

indra: small ask 1
could we add a short one-line status when you flip the canary? e.g. "canary=up | 10m | stable" so oncall can scan.

taylor: agreed. Canary flip etiquette: post one-line status in the canary thread, include canary id, time, and any quick metrics (P95, error-rate).

sketch: (note: "sketch" is shorthand here)

sasha: FYI 1 embedding-service has a tokenizer mismatch failing local regression. I'll cut a quick fix PR and run smoke.

sasha: PR #4988 created, run smoke now.

kai: Will the stricter perf guardrail affect rollout cadence for large-token services?

taylor: For heavy-token services we'll accept longer canary durations and possibly staged ramp-ups. Coordinate with eng-sre to schedule extended canary.

indra: who owns approval for stretch exceptions?

taylor: release leads + eng-sre signoff. Put request in the thread with a short risk plan.

devops-bot: opt-out command available for emergency patches. Usage: 
```n/optout --policy release-gates --reason "emergency" --owner @your-name
```
(ops approval required; logs recorded)

kai: acked. I'll reschedule non-critical migration and leave a note.

sasha: smoke passed for PR #4988, canary candidate uploaded.

taylor: thanks. I'll post a short changelog snapshot tomorrow with final canary outcomes and any rollbacks. If anyone hits blockers ping @taylor or escalate in #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
